name: Anatoly Kukel
profession: SAP UX Designer at EPAM Systems
content: I’ve had the pleasure of working with Valeria for over three years, and during this time, I can confidently say that it’s been nothing but a truly positive experience. Her performance has been consistently outstanding - Valeria approaches every task with exceptional attention to detail, precision, and ownership. She doesn’t just execute design tasks; she adds real value by bringing creative alternatives, helping clients see beyond the initial scope, and uncovering new potential in the product. Valeria is also a strong advocate for incorporating modern AI trends into design - not just as a buzzword, but in meaningful, thoughtful ways that elevate both the user experience and the business impact. One of the things I especially value as her manager is her structured approach to work: she communicates clearly, documents thoroughly, and often takes the initiative to introduce order and standards even when those processes are missing on the client side. Her ability to bring clarity and maturity to any project makes her an essential part of the team. It’s truly a privilege to work with Valeria. She’s not only a high-performing designer, but also someone others can learn from every day. I’m genuinely glad to have her on our team!

name: Anna Malysheva
profession: Senior Software Engineer, 8 years in EAS | ReactJS, Next.js
content:
I had the pleasure of working closely with Valeria on a cross-functional project, and she made the collaboration between design and engineering incredibly smooth.

She built a robust, scalable design system with clear, developer-friendly documentation that made implementation efficient and intuitive. On top of that, she was always proactive, quick to clarify open questions, and genuinely supportive — making her an ideal partner in fast-paced environments.

Working with Valeria meant less back-and-forth, fewer blockers, and more time spent delivering quality. She's a true force multiplier for any cross-functional team. I'd jump at the chance to work with her again and highly recommend her to any team.
